I’m very disappointed with the approach of this dental clinic. I specifically requested a teeth cleaning using the Airflow method. I was given a price quote of 2,000 THB and an appointment was scheduled. However, when I arrived, I was told the price was 2,050 THB, and that I would receive a free dental checkup.

I went in, and they immediately began the checkup. They claimed I needed four fillings and were ready to start the procedure without informing me of the price. Only after I asked did they say it would be 1,000 THB per filling, and asked if I wanted to proceed. I made it clear that I came in only for a cleaning.

The teeth cleaning itself was very unpleasant, to say the least. The dentist and assistant were chatting with each other the entire time. Even though I don’t understand Thai, it was clear that this was not a professional discussion, but rather casual conversation and laughing during what was a painful and uncomfortable treatment.

Most of the cleaning was done using the old, painful method, and the use of the Airflow device was minimal – less than a minute at the end. I feel completely misled. I didn’t feel comfortable expressing this at the clinic, but I must say it now: While the cleaning may have been technically adequate, the business conduct of this clinic is unacceptable, and I do not recommend visiting.

I’ve had proper Airflow treatments before — this was not one of them. Even as a standard cleaning, this experience was bad.

text: I had an excellent experience at my recent dental visit. The consultation for Invisalign included a thorough X-ray and a detailed explanation of the procedure. Dentist Dr. Bee was highly professional, fluent in English, and provided a clear 3D visualization of how Invisalign would correct my teeth. I also received deep cleaning from dentist Dr. Fah who was exceptionally gentle, leaving my teeth spotless. Additionally, she repaired several chipped teeth that I had from combative sports, and the results were flawless. The quality of care and attention to detail was truly impressive. I highly recommend this dental office and will definitely return for future services.

I had my teeth cleaned here twice. It was terrible. Too much pressure probing my molars. I could hear the enamel breaking. The scaling was not 100% completed leaving many rough places on my teeth. There was unnecessary contact with the equipment scribbling all over the fronts of my teeth. I'm pretty sure it was a rotary bit though. For some weird reason my gums recede after every visit. The polishing was nothing more than smearing the paste over the front with their thumb and giving it a spin. No stain was removed and no rough places from mechanical scaling were removed. Only one face of the tooth was polished and only the front teeth. If you have perfect teeth with no cavities do not go here. I clean my own teeth now with assistance on video chat. There was also no donning of a new gown or gloves between patients. Dirty.

This is by far the best dental facility I’ve ever been to and I recommend contacting them to set up an appointment if you’re not satisfied with your current dentist or are just looking to upgrade! Their equipment is all high quality and you won’t find better care anywhere else in Phuket! Highly recommended!!

text: The dentist provided excellent care. I've had treatment for two years, and my teeth are noticeably straighter. I feel much more confident when I smile. The place is clean, and the staff are friendly and helpful. The dentist explained …

I've been getting braces from Dr. Bee since I was a child, around 8th grade (middle school), and now I'm in 11th grade (high school). It took almost 4 years, which is considered fast because my teeth were crooked and difficult to straighten – my molars are smaller than my front teeth. Dr. Bee is very gentle. She did everything from setting anchors, extracting teeth (including wisdom teeth), fillings, and fitting braces – and it was painless. The doctor might say it might be a bit painful, but in reality, all the dentists involved were incredibly gentle. Scaling might cause some sensitivity, which is normal. The doctor gave great advice and explained how to use the dental appliances and how to care for my teeth. Regarding the price, I asked friends who had similar braces, and mine was more expensive, but the time and quality made it worth it. Their system is excellent. Waiting times are short; each time I went, I waited no more than 5 minutes before being called in. The doctor and dental assistants are polite, friendly, and chatty (even for someone like me who isn't very talkative), so it didn't feel pressured.
I love this place so much! My braces treatment went on so quickly! The staff are attentive, the doctor is lovely, and the service is friendly. 🦷🪥 Highly recommend! …
